hook.text: A car swerves toward you. In milliseconds your heart races, pupils dilate, and muscles tense.

buildup.text: The sympathetic nervous system triggers this response. Adrenaline floods your body, prepping you for action.

discovery.text: Blood diverts from digestion to muscles. Pain sensitivity drops. Reaction time sharpens. You become a survival machine.

twist.text: Modern stress triggers the same system. A harsh email activates the same response as a predator once did.

climax.text: Chronic activation causes damage: high blood pressure, weakened immunity, anxiety.

punchline.text: A survival system running nonstop. That's modern stress.

quiz.question: Why is chronic fight-or-flight activation harmful?
options: It causes high blood pressure and weakened immunity
It shrinks muscle tissue over time
